# @lyndon/ui

> Animated React 19 components in the shadcn style: Tailwind CSS (v4 or v3) for styling, motion for animation, themes as
> CSS variables (seven palette families, light and dark). Forms, overlays, navigation, data grid, charts, diagrams, maps,
> media, AI chat and agent UIs. Every component is also a self-contained .tsx drop-in file.

Version 0.8.0. Source: https://github.com/lantos1618/oneshot-ui. Docs: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/. Licence: MIT with a revenue threshold (free up to USD 200k ARR).

## Use it

- Install: `npm i @lyndon/ui motion` (peer deps react@19, react-dom@19). Import from `@lyndon/ui` or a subpath (`@lyndon/ui/charts`).
- Styles: Tailwind v4 `@source "../node_modules/@lyndon/ui/dist";`, or without Tailwind `import '@lyndon/ui/styles.css'`.
- Wrap the app once in `<UIProvider>`: it injects the theme tokens, applies the theme (light/dark/system), hosts toasts.
- Colours only through tokens: `bg-[var(--card)]`, `text-[var(--fg2)]`, `border-[var(--line)]`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--ok|warn|bad)`. Override a component's class with Tailwind's `!` prefix.
- Strict CSP: `<UIProvider injectStyles={false}>` plus `import '@lyndon/ui/tokens.css'`, or pass `nonce`.

## Drop-in files (for AI chats and copy-paste)

Each file below is one component (or a small family) with exactly the helpers it needs, importing only react, react-dom
and motion. Attach the ones you need plus ui-provider.tsx; they share one UIProvider. Sizes are approximate tokens.

- CLI (offline, from the installed package): `npx @lyndon/ui add data-grid dialog --dir src/components/ui`, `npx @lyndon/ui list`, `npx @lyndon/ui info data-grid`
- shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/r/data-grid.json` (pulls in ui-provider)
- Index with sizes, exports and embedded components: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/index.json
- The same files from npm: https://unpkg.com/@lyndon/ui@0.8.0/dist-registry/files/<name>.tsx
- Whole library in one file (dist-single/ui-all.tsx, ~633.0k tokens): only for tools with a very large context; prefer the drop-ins

## Foundation

### Hooks (`hooks`, ~8.4k tokens)

Shared hooks: controlled-or-uncontrolled state, outside clicks, disclosure, element size, media queries, pointer drags, long press, hotkeys, focus trap, roving focus, streamed text and scroll edges.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hooks.tsx
- Exports: useControllable, useOutside, useDisclosure, useWidth, useSize, useMediaQuery, useCoarsePointer, usePointerDrag, useLongPress, useHotkey, useFocusTrap, useRoving, useStreamedText, useScrollEdges
- npm: react

### Locale provider (`locale-provider`, ~7.2k tokens)

Provides the locale to everything below (UIProvider renders one; use it directly to localise one subtree).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/locale-provider.tsx
- Exports: LocaleProvider
- npm: react

### Arabic UI strings (`messages-ar`, ~2.2k tokens)

Arabic strings for the built-in UI (right to left from the locale): <UIProvider locale="ar-EG" messages={UI_MESSAGES_AR}>. Machine-drafted; have a native speaker review them.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/messages-ar.tsx
- Exports: UI_MESSAGES_AR

### German UI strings (`messages-de`, ~1.9k tokens)

German strings for the built-in UI: <UIProvider locale="de-DE" messages={UI_MESSAGES_DE}>. Machine-drafted; have a native speaker review them.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/messages-de.tsx
- Exports: UI_MESSAGES_DE

### Motion helpers (`motion`, ~2.7k tokens)

Reveal on scroll, useViewport (pause work off screen), frame loops, tweens, play/shake keyframes and motion presets.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/motion.tsx
- Exports: Reveal, useViewport, useFrameLoop, useTween, play, shake, MOTION_PRESETS, motionTransition, EASE_OUT
- npm: motion, react

### UI hosts (`ui-hosts`, ~801 tokens)

Renders the registered hosts (UIProvider includes it). Only the first mounted outlet on the page renders them.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-hosts.tsx
- Exports: UIHosts
- npm: react

### UIProvider (`ui-provider`, ~19.8k tokens)

Wrap your app once: injects the theme tokens (CSS variables), applies and saves the theme (light, dark, system, seven palettes), provides the locale (English strings; add messages-de / messages-ar for those), hosts page-level UI such as the toast region and turns motion off for reduced-motion users. ThemeScript applies the saved theme before paint. Every other drop-in needs it; toasts, icons, translations and the appearance menu are separate items.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/ui-provider.tsx
- Exports: UIProvider, ThemeScript, useTheme, themeScriptSource
- Embeds: LocaleProvider, UIHosts
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Utilities (`utils`, ~5.0k tokens)

Pure helpers: cn() and variants() for class names, spring() for motion, safeUrl/safeColor for model output, number and date formatting, clamp, mix and contrast.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/utils.tsx
- Exports: cn, variants, spring, sleep, clamp, mix, contrast, safeUrl, safeMediaUrl, safeColor, safeCssValue, cssUrl, fmt, fmtDate, maxOf, minOf, extent


## Primitives

### Animated number (`animated-number`, ~3.1k tokens)

Rolling number (replaces the NumberFlow web component): each digit rolls to its new value. format: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, e.g. { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }. Screen readers get the formatted value as visually hidden text (the rolling columns are aria-hidden). Digits are tabular and each takes one fixed column, so the number never shifts the layout around it while it rolls. Cheap enough for live tickers: each digit is one CSS transform transition (one style write per change, none per frame), nothing is written when a digit is unchanged, and the roll is skipped (the digit jumps) for reduced motion and while the number is off screen.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/animated-number.tsx
- Exports: AnimatedNumber
- npm: motion, react

### Avatar (`avatar`, ~3.3k tokens)

Avatar from @lyndon/ui.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/avatar.tsx
- Exports: Avatar, AvatarStack
- npm: motion, react

### Badge (`badge`, ~2.7k tokens)

Status pill, tag or count: the one badge primitive. `size` sm (18px, for counts, deltas and dense rows) or md (20px, default). Pair colour with a dot or word: never colour alone.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/badge.tsx
- Exports: Badge, DeltaBadge
- npm: motion, react

### Button (`button`, ~6.2k tokens)

Every button presses down slightly (scale .96), like the original page. `asChild` renders your element instead (`<Button asChild><a href="/docs">Docs</a></Button>`): same look, and `disabled`/`loading` become aria-disabled plus a blocked click (the spinner only shows on a real <button>).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/button.tsx
- Exports: Button, IconButton, buttonVariants
- Embeds: Icon, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Card (`card`, ~624 tokens)

Surface for grouping content.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/card.tsx
- Exports: Card, Separator
- npm: react

### Chip (`chip`, ~2.2k tokens)

Pill button for filters, toggles and suggestions. With `pressed` it is a toggle (aria-pressed, filled when on); without, a plain suggestion chip. 30px tall, 36px on touch. Takes every button prop.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chip.tsx
- Exports: Chip
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Icon (`icon`, ~3.4k tokens)

Every icon (inline SVG paths) and <Icon>. Other drop-ins embed only the icons they draw: add this file to pass any icon name (icon="trash") to their props, or register your own paths with registerIcons().

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/icon.tsx
- Exports: Icon, ICONS, registerIcons, iconPath, isIconName
- npm: react

### Kbd (`kbd`, ~458 tokens)

A key or shortcut ("⌘K", "Esc"). Always left to right, so "⌘K" doesn't turn into "K⌘" in RTL text.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/kbd.tsx
- Exports: Kbd
- npm: react

### Scroll edges (`scroll-edges`, ~3.9k tokens)

Edge fades for a horizontal scroller, plus (on touch screens, until the first scroll) a small "swipe for more" pill on the end side (right in LTR, left in RTL). Render it as a sibling of the scroller inside a `relative` wrapper; feed it `useScrollEdges`. `hint` defaults to the locale's "Swipe for more"; pass `null` to hide it.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/scroll-edges.tsx
- Exports: ScrollEdges
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Skeleton (`skeleton`, ~652 tokens)

Loading placeholder with a shimmer sweep (paused while off screen; off for reduced motion).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/skeleton.tsx
- Exports: Skeleton
- npm: motion, react

### Slot (`slot`, ~1.3k tokens)

Renders its single child with its own props merged in (see the asChild contract above). The engine behind every `asChild`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slot.tsx
- Exports: Slot
- npm: react

### Spark chart (`spark-chart`, ~2.5k tokens)

Word-sized chart for tables and tiles. Variants: 'line' (optional end dot and min/max dots), 'bars' (last bar highlighted), 'winloss' (up/down against the previous value) and 'area' (optional dashed `target`). Fills its container's width unless `width` is set.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spark-chart.tsx
- Exports: SparkChart
- npm: motion, react

### Spinner (`spinner`, ~2.3k tokens)

Spinning ring (role=status, "Loading" in the provider's language). `tone` colours it; default is the text colour.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/spinner.tsx
- Exports: Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Status icon (`status-icon`, ~2.5k tokens)

Round step/status marker for steppers, checks and task lists: done (filled tick, pops in), failed (filled ✕), active (spinning ring, or the step `number` in a bold ring), pending (grey ring, with `number` if given). `tone="ok"` paints done green. Decorative unless you pass `label`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/status-icon.tsx
- Exports: StatusIcon
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react


## Forms and inputs

### Calendar (`calendar`, ~16.2k tokens)

Month grid (an ARIA grid; day cells grow to 40×40 on touch). Always controlled: a single date is `selected` + `onSelect`, a range is `range` + `onRangeChange` (pass one pair); `month` is only the month shown first. Weekday and month names, digits and the first day of the week follow the locale (`locale`, `weekStartsOn`, or UIProvider's). `min`, `max` and `isDateUnavailable(date)` disable days (they stay focusable and are announced as unavailable; a range can't start or end on one). `numberOfMonths` shows up to 3 months (stacked on phones). Click the month caption for a month grid, and its year for a year grid, to jump far. Keyboard (ARIA APG date grid): arrows move by day/week across months (mirrored in RTL), Home/End go to the start/end of the week, PageUp/PageDown change month (with Shift, year), Enter or Space picks. In range mode Shift+arrow or Shift+click extends the range from its anchor; you can also click start then end, drag across days, or drag either end of an existing range. On touch, drag an end of the range, or long-press a day and then drag to draw a new one, so a swipe over the grid still scrolls the page. Months slide in the direction you move; the picked day pops.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/calendar.tsx
- Exports: Calendar
- npm: motion, react

### Checkbox (`checkbox`, ~4.3k tokens)

Checkbox with a drawn checkmark; `children` is its label. Form-native like Switch: `name`/`value`, `required` (must be ticked), `disabled` (the box fades, the label stays legible in --fg3), `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, `ref`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/checkbox.tsx
- Exports: Checkbox, CheckboxBox, CheckMark
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Color picker (`color-picker`, ~19.8k tokens)

Swatches, a hue slider and a hex field. The preview pops when a swatch or hex changes it (not while dragging hue). `hueMagnets` pulls the hue thumb onto the primary hues (or your own marks) while dragging; see Slider's `magnets`. Form-native: `name` submits "#RRGGBB" (upper case; the last valid colour while the hex field holds a typo), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly` (shows the colour and hex only), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the hex field.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/color-picker.tsx
- Exports: ColorPicker
- Embeds: FormFieldContext, Input, MagnetBubble, MagnetMarks
- npm: motion, react

### Combobox (`combobox`, ~27.2k tokens)

Type to filter (the match is bolded), arrows to move, Enter to choose. Options can carry a `leading` flag or emoji, shown in the field once chosen, and a `group` heading. `empty` renders the no-match message for the current query.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/combobox.tsx
- Exports: Combobox
- Embeds: Button, CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Icon, OptionList, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Currency input (`currency-input`, ~9.1k tokens)

Amount field: thousands separators appear while you type, using the currency's locale (1’234.50 CHF, 1.234,50 EUR…), at most two decimals. Tap the code to cycle currencies; the formatted amount is written out below. Controlled with `value` (a number, or null for empty) or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`. Form-native: `name` submits the amount as a plain number string ("1234.5", '' when empty; no separators or symbol), `currencyName` also submits the currency code ("CHF"); `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the amount field. Reset returns to `defaultValue` and `defaultCurrency`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/currency-input.tsx
- Exports: CurrencyInput
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Date field (`date-field`, ~15.5k tokens)

Typed date entry: day, month and year segments in the locale's order, separators and digits (en-GB dd/mm/yyyy, en-US mm/dd/yyyy, de-DE tt.mm.jjjj, ja-JP yyyy/mm/dd). Type digits (a segment moves on once it can't take another), ↑/↓ step a segment (PageUp/PageDown further), ←/→ move between segments, Backspace clears digit by digit, and pasting "2026-11-08" or a date in the locale's format fills them all. `min`, `max` and `isDateUnavailable` mark the date invalid and stop a form submit with a message (as does a half-typed date). Value: a local Date at midnight, or null while empty or incomplete. Form-native: `name` submits "2026-11-08" ('' when empty), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the first segment.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-field.tsx
- Exports: DateField
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: react

### Date picker (`date-picker`, ~28.4k tokens)

Date field: the calendar pops from the field (keyboard ready), the picked day pops, Today and Clear sit under the grid. Shows the weekday, in the locale. `min`, `max`, `isDateUnavailable`, `weekStartsOn`, `locale` and `numberOfMonths` go to the Calendar; a value outside them is marked invalid and stops a form submit with a message. Form-native: `name` submits the local date as "2026-11-08" (like <input type="date">; '' when empty), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly` (doesn't open), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the trigger. For typing a date, use DateField.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-picker.tsx
- Exports: DatePicker, formatDate
- Embeds: Button, Calendar, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Date range picker (`date-range-picker`, ~29.2k tokens)

Range picker with presets (the matching preset stays highlighted; presets that fall outside `min`/`max` or start or end on an unavailable day are disabled). Stays open so you can drag either end to adjust; Done closes it. Takes the Calendar's `min`, `max`, `isDateUnavailable`, `weekStartsOn`, `locale` and `numberOfMonths` (2 is a good fit on desktop; phones stack them). Form-native: `name` submits two fields, start then end ("2026-11-01", "2026-11-07"; '' for a missing side; read with formData.getAll), `required` (both ends), `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, `ref`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-range-picker.tsx
- Exports: DateRangePicker
- Embeds: Badge, Button, Calendar, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Date time field (`date-time-field`, ~17.7k tokens)

Typed date and time in one field: the locale's date segments, then hour, minute (second) and am/pm, then the time zone's short name. Same keys as DateField and TimeField; pasting an ISO string with an offset shows that instant in `timeZone`. `granularity` 'day' | 'hour' | 'minute' | 'second'. Value: an ISO 8601 string with the offset of `timeZone` at that instant, "2026-11-08T09:30:00+01:00" (so `new Date(value)` is the instant and the wall time is readable); around daylight-saving changes a skipped time moves forward and a repeated one takes the first. null while empty or incomplete. `min`/`max` (instants) and `isDateUnavailable` mark it invalid. Form-native: `name` submits the ISO string ('' when empty), `timeZoneName` also submits the zone, plus `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the first segment.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-field.tsx
- Exports: DateTimeField
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: react

### Date time picker (`date-time-picker`, ~39.1k tokens)

Date and time picker: a DateTimeField with a calendar button (or Alt+↓) opening the Calendar with a TimeField under it, and with `timeZonePicker` a searchable time-zone picker beside it. Same value as DateTimeField: an ISO 8601 string with the zone's offset, "2026-11-08T09:30:00+01:00". Picking another zone keeps the wall time (09:30 stays 09:30, the offset changes) and calls `onTimeZoneChange`; `timeZone` controls the zone, `defaultTimeZone` seeds it. Picking a day with no time yet sets midnight. Takes the Calendar's `weekStartsOn` and `numberOfMonths`. Form-native like DateTimeField.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/date-time-picker.tsx
- Exports: DateTimePicker
- Embeds: Button, Calendar, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### File upload (`file-upload`, ~14.1k tokens)

Drop zone + file list. Each file shows a progress bar and "Uploading → Uploaded"; removed rows slide out and collapse. Pass `upload(file, onProgress)` to upload for real (otherwise progress is simulated) and `defaultFiles` to seed the list. Dropped and picked files are filtered by `accept` (and to one file without `multiple`); skipped ones go to `onReject` and a note under the zone. `accept` only checks the name and reported type: validate type, size and content on the server. Form-native: with `name`, the files in the list (picked or dropped) are submitted as a native file field (multipart FormData / server actions; `defaultFiles` have no content and aren't sent); `required` (at least one file), `disabled`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the drop zone. Reset restores `defaultFiles`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/file-upload.tsx
- Exports: FileUpload, fileAccepts
- Embeds: Button, FormFieldContext, Icon, IconButton, Progress, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Form (`form`, ~8.4k tokens)

A <form> that validates its fields and shows the messages in its FormFields, with no form library. On submit it checks every field (native inputs and the custom controls' required proxies alike), shows each failing field's message under it, focuses the first one and doesn't submit; once a submit has failed, messages update as fields change. When everything is valid it calls `onSubmit(event)` and `onValues(formData, event)` (which also prevents the page load). `errors` adds messages of your own by field name (from the server or a schema); they win over the browser's. `validationBehavior="native"` keeps the browser's own bubbles instead. `action` works as usual (server actions get the FormData, custom controls included). Reset returns uncontrolled controls to their `defaultValue` and clears messages.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/form.tsx
- Exports: Form, FormField, Field, Label, FormFieldContext, useFormControl, useFormFieldProps, useControllableState
- npm: react

### Inline date picker (`inline-date-picker`, ~33.2k tokens)

Inline date picker card with two modes: one date, or a range. Type into the date fields (DateField: the locale's order and digits; the calendar jumps to the typed month) or pick on the calendar (drag across days in range mode). The footer spells out the choice, counts the days, and Clear resets it. Composes `DateField` and `Calendar`; takes the Calendar's `min`, `max`, `isDateUnavailable`, `weekStartsOn` and `locale`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/inline-date-picker.tsx
- Exports: InlineDatePicker
- Embeds: ActiveIndicator, Badge, Button, Calendar, DateField, FormFieldContext, Icon, SegmentedControl, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Input (`input`, ~1.8k tokens)

Text input. Set `invalid` to show the error ring; it shakes once when it becomes invalid. Your `ref` reaches the <input>. Inside a FormField it takes the field's id, name, flags and aria-describedby. Disabled and read-only get a muted fill.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/input.tsx
- Exports: Input
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Month picker (`month-picker`, ~20.2k tokens)

Month and year picker: a field that opens a grid of months (its title opens a grid of years), in the locale. `min`/`max` disable months outside them. Value: a Date on the first of the month (null when empty). Form-native: `name` submits "2026-11" (like <input type="month">), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, `ref`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/month-picker.tsx
- Exports: MonthPicker
- Embeds: Button, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Multi select (`multi-select`, ~29.0k tokens)

Pick several: ticks draw in the list, chosen items become chips (with their colour dot) in the field. Backspace removes the last chip. With `loadOptions(query, { signal })` the field becomes a search box: loads run `debounce` ms (200) after typing stops, once the query has `minChars`; a newer query aborts the older request; the list shows loading, empty and error states (Retry, or Enter); `defaultOptions` show before the first load, options can carry a `group`, and `creatable` adds “Create “x”” (`onCreate(text)` may return the Option to use). Picking keeps the list open and the query, so several results can be ticked in a row. Chosen values keep their labels across searches. Form-native: `name` submits each value as its own field (name=a&name=b; read with formData.getAll), `required` (at least one), `disabled`, `readOnly` (chips only), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the field (the search input when async). Long lists are virtualised.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/multi-select.tsx
- Exports: MultiSelect
- Embeds: Button, CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Icon, OptionList, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Number stepper (`number-stepper`, ~10.7k tokens)

− value + with a rolling number. The whole control is one spinbutton tab stop: ↑/→ and ↓/← step, Home and End jump to min and max, and it wiggles when you push past either limit. Form-native: `name` submits the number as a plain string ("3"); `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the spinbutton. Inside a FormField the field's label names it (otherwise `label`).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/number-stepper.tsx
- Exports: NumberStepper
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, FormFieldContext, Icon
- npm: motion, react

### OTP input (`otp-input`, ~9.1k tokens)

One-time code: auto-advance, paste fills every box, typing into a filled box replaces and re-pops it. `onChange` fires with the partial code on every edit (use it to reset your hint), `onComplete` with the full code. Controlled with `value` (set it to '' to clear the boxes) or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`; `length` may change. Pass `status="bad"` after a wrong code and the boxes shake (again on every wrong attempt); `"ok"` makes them hop. Form-native: `name` submits the digits typed so far ("123456"), `required` (every box filled), `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid` (same look as status "bad"), `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the first box.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/otp-input.tsx
- Exports: OTPInput
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Password input (`password-input`, ~11.1k tokens)

Password with show/hide (the eye pops when it flips). `strength` adds four bars that fill in a stagger and a rules checklist (8+ characters, uppercase, number, symbol) that ticks green as each is met.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/password-input.tsx
- Exports: PasswordInput
- Embeds: Button, FormFieldContext, Icon, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Phone input (`phone-input`, ~25.5k tokens)

Phone number with a country picker (flags and dial codes). Digits are formatted with the country's mask as you type, and the digits still to come show as a grey placeholder. Typing `+44…` or `0044…` switches the country. Controlled with `value` (E.164, e.g. "+41791234567": a new value picks the country and digits) or uncontrolled with `defaultCountry` + `defaultValue` (national digits). Form-native: `name` submits E.164 ("+41791234567"; '' while no digits are typed), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the number field. Reset returns to the default country and digits.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/phone-input.tsx
- Exports: PhoneInput
- Embeds: CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Icon, OptionList
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Radio group (`radio-group`, ~6.7k tokens)

Radio group with arrow-key navigation. Form-native: `name` submits the chosen value ('' when none), `required`, `disabled` (every option), `readOnly` (arrows move focus only), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the radio that holds the Tab stop. Inside a FormField the group is labelled by the field's label.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/radio-group.tsx
- Exports: RadioGroup
- Embeds: FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Rating (`rating`, ~9.6k tokens)

1–5 stars: every lit star pops again in sequence on each pick. Arrow keys change the rating. Form-native: `name` submits the rating ("4"; '' while unrated), `required` (must be rated), `disabled`, `readOnly` (shows the stars, no picking), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the star holding the Tab stop.

### Segmented control (`segmented-control`, ~7.6k tokens)

Segmented control with a sliding pill: a single choice, so it is a radiogroup (role=radio + aria-checked). One Tab stop (the chosen segment); ←/→ (and ↑/↓) move and select, Home/End jump. Name the group with `aria-label` (or a FormField label). Form-native: `name` submits the value; `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, `ref`.

### Select (`select`, ~22.8k tokens)

Custom select: arrows, Enter/Space, type-ahead that cycles through options starting with the typed letter (works closed too), springs open, flips upward near the bottom of the viewport, checkmark on the current option. Form-native: `name` submits the value ('' when none), `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly` (doesn't open), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the trigger button. Long lists are virtualised.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/select.tsx
- Exports: Select, OptionList
- Embeds: CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Icon
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Slider (`slider`, ~22.0k tokens)

Range slider with live value. `disabled` fades only the track (label and value stay legible in --fg3; the group gets aria-disabled). Native input: keyboard and screen readers for free, a 32px hit area on touch. `steps` makes it a stepped picker over named stops (value = index; the names show under the track and can be tapped). `compact` uses a smaller grey readout (settings panels). `magnets` (see useMagnet) pull the thumb onto marks while dragging: ticks and zone bands on the track, the mark's label in a bubble over the thumb, a spring as it settles, a tick on touch, "Snapped to …" announced. Hold Alt (Option) or put a second finger down to drag freely; PageUp / PageDown and Ctrl/⌘ + arrows jump between marks, arrows still step. The value stays a plain number (forms submit it as usual). `valueText` names a value for screen readers.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/slider.tsx
- Exports: Slider, RangeSlider
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, FormFieldContext, MagnetBubble, MagnetMarks
- npm: motion, react

### Switch (`switch`, ~5.1k tokens)

Toggle. The knob springs across and stretches (squash replays on every toggle). Form-native: `name`/`value` (submits like a native checkbox), `required` (must be on), `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the switch button. `label` puts it in a clickable row.

### Tag input (`tag-input`, ~8.3k tokens)

Type and press Enter (or comma) to add; Backspace on empty removes the last tag. Duplicates wiggle. IME-safe. Form-native: `name` submits each tag as its own field (name=a&name=b, so tags may contain commas; read them with formData.getAll), `required` (at least one tag), `disabled`, `readOnly` (chips only), `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the text input. A tag still being typed is added on blur.

### Textarea (`textarea`, ~7.2k tokens)

Auto-growing textarea; the height animates as lines are added or removed. With `maxLength` it shows "N left" and a ring that fills toward the limit, turning amber under 20 and red under 5, and pops at 0.

### Time field (`time-field`, ~21.1k tokens)

Typed time entry: hour and minute (and second) segments, with an am/pm segment on a 12-hour clock (from the locale or `hourCycle`); type "930" or "9" then ":" and "30", ↑/↓ step a segment, "a"/"p" sets am/pm, pasting "14:30" or "2:30 PM" fills it. `min`/`max` ("08:00", "18:00") mark it invalid. `step` adds a clock button with suggested times every `step` minutes (between `from` and `to`), outside min/max disabled; Alt+↓ opens it. `timeZone` shows the zone's short name after the time (the value is the wall time there). Value: "09:30" (24-hour, like <input type="time">; "09:30:15" with granularity="second"), '' while empty or incomplete. Form-native: `name` submits it, `required`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `onBlur`, `form`, and `ref` on the first segment.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/time-field.tsx
- Exports: TimeField
- Embeds: FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext
- npm: motion, react

### Time picker (`time-picker`, ~21.2k tokens)

Time picker: a TimeField (type the time, or step it with ↑/↓) plus a clock button listing times every `step` minutes (15) between `from` and `to` (07:00 to 21:00), opening scrolled to the current one. The 0.3 props still work (`value`, `defaultValue` "09:00", `onChange`, `step`, `from`, `to`); it also takes TimeField's `hourCycle`, `locale`, `granularity`, `min`, `max` and `timeZone`. `name` submits "HH:MM" (24-hour, like <input type="time">).

Searchable time-zone picker: a Combobox of `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')` (about 420 zones, virtualised), labelled with their current offset, "(GMT+01:00) Europe/Zurich", and sorted by it; type a city or "GMT+05". `zones` limits the list, `at` is the instant the offsets are for (default now). Value: the IANA name. Form-native like Combobox.

## Overlays

### Alert dialog (`alert-dialog`, ~15.1k tokens)

Confirmation for a consequential action (role="alertdialog"). It needs a `title` and a `description`, never closes on an outside click (the panel shakes instead), and opens with focus on the least destructive action, Cancel. Escape or Cancel close it. `onConfirm` may return a promise: Confirm then shows a spinner and both buttons wait; it closes when the promise resolves, and stays open with the error's message (announced) when it rejects. Parts: AlertDialog.Root / Trigger / Content / Title / Description / Footer / Cancel (= Close) / Action.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/alert-dialog.tsx
- Exports: AlertDialog, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogAction
- Embeds: Button, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogRoot, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, Icon, ModalLayer, OverlayPortal, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Command palette (`command-palette`, ~22.2k tokens)

⌘K palette: type to filter (every word must match the label, keywords or hint), arrows to move, Enter to run. Groups keep together under their headings. Shows which keyword matched, marks the active row with ↵, and suggests a query when nothing matches. `loadItems(query, { signal })` adds results from your API (debounced by `debounce` ms, the previous request aborted, a spinner while loading, errors shown). Entries with `children` / `loadChildren` open nested pages (Enter in, Backspace on an empty search out, or click the breadcrumb). `recents` keeps the last N entries run as a Recent group (persisted under `recentKey`). Long result lists are virtualised.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/command-palette.tsx
- Exports: CommandPalette
- Embeds: Icon, Kbd, MenuLabel, ModalLayer, OverlayPortal, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Context menu (`context-menu`, ~17.2k tokens)

Right-click, long-press (touch) or press the Menu key / Shift+F10 on the focused area to open a menu at that point. Items can have submenus (→ opens, ← closes). The menu stays inside the viewport, focuses its first item, and closes on Escape, outside click, scroll or resize. `children` may be a function of `open` so the target can highlight itself. Parts: ContextMenu.Root/Trigger/Content plus the menu item parts (Item, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, Label, Separator, Group, Sub, SubTrigger, SubContent, Shortcut).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/context-menu.tsx
- Exports: ContextMenu, MenuItem, MenuSeparator, MenuLabel, MenuGroup, MenuShortcut, MenuCheckboxItem, MenuRadioGroup, MenuRadioItem, MenuSub, MenuSubTrigger, MenuSubContent, ContextMenuRoot, ContextMenuTrigger, ContextMenuContent
- Embeds: Icon, Kbd, OverlayPortal, Slot
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Dialog (`dialog`, ~11.5k tokens)

Modal dialog. Springs in, backdrop fades, focus is trapped, Escape closes. Fits small screens: keeps clear of the safe areas, scrolls inside when taller than the screen, and the footer wraps. Parts: Dialog.Root / Trigger (asChild) / Content / Title / Description / Close (asChild) / Footer.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/dialog.tsx

- Embeds: Button, Icon, IconButton, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Dropdown menu (`dropdown-menu`, ~17.7k tokens)

<DropdownMenu trigger="Options"><MenuItem shortcut="E">Edit</MenuItem>…</DropdownMenu> Opens with click, Enter or ↓; the first item takes focus and the rest stagger in. ↑/↓, Home/End and typeahead move; Tab or moving focus away closes it. - Embeds: Button, FloatingPanel, Icon, Kbd, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Hover card (`hover-card`, ~8.8k tokens)

Rich preview on hover or focus (profiles, links, citations). Stays open while the pointer is over the card. On touch, tapping the trigger toggles it and tapping outside closes it. With `pinOnClick`, a mouse click on the trigger pins the card open (leaving no longer closes it) until another click, an outside click or Escape. The card slides to stay on screen. Parts: HoverCard.Root / HoverCard.Trigger (asChild) / HoverCard.Content (side, align, sideOffset, arrow).

Click (or Enter) to edit; Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels. With `helper`, a line below shows e.g. "Last edited 2 h ago" and turns into a green `savedHelper` after a change; the text flashes on save.

### Sheet (`sheet`, ~12.5k tokens)

Panel that slides in from an edge: `side` is `end` (default; the right in LTR, the left in RTL), `start`, the physical `left`/`right`, or `bottom`. On screens narrower than 640px a side sheet becomes a bottom sheet (pass `responsive={false}` to keep the edge drawer, e.g. for app navigation). A bottom sheet has a grab handle: drag it (or the header) down to dismiss. Keeps clear of the safe areas. Parts: Sheet.Root / Trigger / Content (side, responsive) / Header / Title / Description / Close / Footer.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sheet.tsx
- Exports: Sheet, SheetContent, SheetHeader
- Embeds: Button, DialogClose, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogRoot, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, Icon, IconButton, ModalLayer, OverlayPortal, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Tooltip (`tooltip`, ~7.2k tokens)

Short delay, quick fade. Wrap the element that should show it. Shows on hover or keyboard focus; on touch a tap shows it (another tap, a tap elsewhere or 2.5 s hides it). `portal` renders it in a fixed layer so it escapes `overflow: hidden` parents (collapsed sidebars, scroll areas); `disabled` turns it off. The trigger (a single element child) gets `aria-describedby` while the tip shows, so screen readers announce it. Parts: Tooltip.Root (open state, delay) / Tooltip.Trigger (asChild) / Tooltip.Content (side, align, sideOffset, arrow, portal).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tooltip.tsx
- Exports: Tooltip, PointerTooltip, usePointerTooltip, useHoverIntent, TooltipRoot, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent
- Embeds: OverlayPortal, Slot
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Tour (`tour`, ~9.8k tokens)

Guided tour over a region. Mark targets inside `children` with data-tour="…"; the spotlight springs between them and a tooltip with an arrow anchors below each one (above if there's no room). `step` is the open step (-1 = closed). Next/Done, Skip, ←/→ (mirrored in RTL) and Escape work. The spotlight and tooltip are placed from measured geometry, so they are physical by nature.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tour.tsx
- Exports: Tour
- Embeds: Button, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react


## Navigation

### Mega menu (`mega-menu`, ~10.6k tokens)

Site header whose menus share one panel. Hover or focus a top item to open it (it waits `closeDelay` ms before closing, so you can travel to the panel); moving to another item morphs the panel's size and position while the content slides in from that side. Keyboard: ←/→ move between the top items (Home/End jump to the ends) and ↓ (or ↑ for the last link) moves into the open panel. Inside the panel ↑↓←→ move through its links as a grid, Home/End jump to the first/last link, ←/→ at the grid's edge go to the neighbouring top item, ↑ from the first row returns to the trigger, and Escape closes the panel and returns focus to its trigger. Items with `href` and no `content` are plain links (`href` passes through safeUrl: http(s), mailto, tel or relative). `children` is the page under the header. Open state: uncontrolled with `defaultOpen` (a top item's label or index, open on mount), or controlled with `open` (label, index, or null for closed) + `onOpenChange(label | null)`, which fires on every open, switch and close.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mega-menu.tsx
- Exports: MegaMenu
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Collapse (`collapse`, ~1.0k tokens)

Animated height. `open` toggles the content between 0 and its height (it unmounts when closed): Accordion, Banner, TreeView and ThinkingSteps use it. While open, the height also follows the content with a spring, so state swaps inside never jump (permission cards, wizards, tabs of different heights). Leave `open` out for that alone (AutoHeight).

### Copy button (`copy-button`, ~6.9k tokens)

Copies `text`. On success the icon swaps to a check and the label (or, icon-only, the accessible name and tooltip) to `copiedLabel` for `duration` ms (default 1.5 s); a refusal shows a warning and `failedLabel`. Either result is announced in a polite live region next to the button. Icon-only for the icon sizes unless `iconOnly={false}`. The label keeps the width of the longer of `label`/`copiedLabel`, so the button doesn't change size. Takes every other button prop.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/copy-button.tsx
- Exports: CopyButton, useCopy
- Embeds: Button, Icon, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Hold to confirm (`hold-to-confirm`, ~9.7k tokens)

Press and hold (pointer, touch, Space or Enter) to confirm a destructive action. The fill sweeps across and the label inverts exactly where the fill has reached; releasing early springs it back. When it completes the button pops, shows `doneLabel`, and resets after `resetAfter` ms. A status line under it reads Keep holding… / Cancelled / done (`status={false}` hides it). `duration` is at least 500 ms. It guards against slips, not against a hostile page: serve pages that use it with `frame-ancestors 'none'` (or 'self') so another site can't frame it and coach a user into holding.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/hold-to-confirm.tsx
- Exports: HoldToConfirm
- Embeds: Button, Icon, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Like button (`like-button`, ~7.3k tokens)

Heart that bursts on like, with a rolling count. Controlled (`liked`) or uncontrolled (`defaultLiked`).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/like-button.tsx
- Exports: LikeButton
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, Button, Icon, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Offline indicator (`offline-indicator`, ~8.2k tokens)

Connection bar for the top of a view. When `online` turns false it slides down, explains that edits are kept locally and counts down to the next automatic retry (calling `onRetry`), with a "Retry now" link; at each retry a small spinner reads "Retrying…" for a second, in place. Back online, the same bar cross-fades to green with `backMessage` and slides away after a moment. One persistent bar: both states share one grid cell, so nothing stacks, jumps or reflows (the countdown has a fixed width), and only appearing/disappearing moves it (a transform, none under reduced motion). Screen readers hear the state changes only, never the countdown. `paused` stops the countdown and automatic retries (e.g. while the view is off screen) without pretending to be online.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/offline-indicator.tsx
- Exports: OfflineIndicator
- Embeds: Icon, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Progress (`progress`, ~3.8k tokens)

Linear progress bar; the fill springs to each new value. `label` names it for screen readers (default "Progress"; say what is progressing).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/progress.tsx
- Exports: Progress, ProgressRing
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber
- npm: motion, react

### Toast (`toast`, ~8.9k tokens)

Hosts its own toasts for the tree inside it. UIProvider no longer needs one (0.4): useToast() outside a ToastProvider uses the page-wide region. At most `max` (default 5) are on screen: a new toast drops the oldest, so a burst of notifications can't pile up without limit. The region stays usable while a modal makes the page inert.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/toast.tsx
- Exports: ToastProvider, useToast
- Embeds: Button, Icon, IconButton, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Typing dots (`typing-dots`, ~2.1k tokens)

Three bouncing dots: someone (the assistant, a teammate) is typing. The bounce pauses while off screen. `label` is announced.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/typing-dots.tsx
- Exports: TypingDots
- npm: motion, react


## Data display

### Accordion (`accordion`, ~6.0k tokens)

Accordion: panels grow to their content height and the chevron rotates. Open panels (by index) are uncontrolled (`defaultOpen`) or controlled (`value` + `onValueChange`); `multiple` lets several stay open. Parts: Accordion.Root (type single|multiple, collapsible) / Item / Trigger (asChild) / Content (forceMount).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/accordion.tsx
- Exports: Accordion, AccordionRoot, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent
- Embeds: Collapse, Icon, Slot
- npm: motion, react

### Animated list (`animated-list`, ~2.2k tokens)

Any list whose items animate in, out and into new positions.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/animated-list.tsx
- Exports: AnimatedList
- npm: motion, react

### Data grid (`data-grid`, ~67.8k tokens)

Data grid, generic over the row type, from a few rows to 100k (rows are virtualised above 100: only the ones in view are in the DOM). Filter with Bricks (chips joined by AND/OR), a Text query (`status is active and mrr > 500`, with highlighting and parse errors) or Scratch-style Blocks with nested groups (drag ⠿) — all three edit one filter. Search every cell ripgrep-style (regex, smart case, whole word, literal; `-i -w -F` flags work too) with highlighted hits. Group by a column with collapsible groups, counts and totals. Click headers to sort, drag their edge to resize, drag a header (or Ctrl+Shift+← →) to reorder; the Columns menu hides, pins (left/right) and reorders. Shift-click checkboxes for ranges, then Export or Delete (with Undo). Double-click a cell to edit; Enter saves, Escape cancels. Keyboard: one Tab stop in the cells, arrows, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter/F2 edits, Space selects. `server` hands sorting, filtering, search and paging to your API (`rowCount`, `page`/`pageSize` or `onLoadMore`, `loading`, `error`); `selection` is controlled with "select all across pages" semantics (see GridSelection).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-grid.tsx
- Exports: DataGrid, gridFilter, gridIsSelected, gridSelectedCount, GRID_NO_SELECTION
- Embeds: ActiveIndicator, Badge, Button, CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, FormFieldContext, Icon, IconButton, OptionList, Popover, PopoverClose, PopoverContent, PopoverRoot, PopoverTrigger, ScrollEdges, SegmentedControl, Select, Skeleton, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Data table (`data-table`, ~3.2k tokens)

Sortable table; rows slide to their new position when the order changes. Sort is uncontrolled (`initialSort`) or controlled (`sort` + `onSortChange`). With `onRowClick` a click anywhere on a row opens it, and the first cell is a real button, so keyboard users Tab to it and press Enter or Space. Scrolls sideways inside its box when too wide.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-table.tsx
- Exports: DataTable
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Json viewer (`json-viewer`, ~14.8k tokens)

JSON tree with typed colours (strings, numbers, booleans, null). Filter highlights matching keys, opens their branches and scrolls to the first hit; click a key to copy its path (e.g. `steps[1].failed`); collapse or expand everything at once. Branches animate open and shut. Cyclic data shows [Circular]; very deep or very large data is cut off with a marker instead of overflowing the stack.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/json-viewer.tsx
- Exports: JsonViewer
- Embeds: Button, Collapse, Icon, IconButton, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Shortcut sheet (`shortcut-sheet`, ~15.5k tokens)

Keyboard shortcuts in titled groups (General / Navigation / Editing…). Inline by default (`columns={2}` lays groups side by side); `variant="dialog"` shows them in a dialog instead, controlled by `open` + `onOpenChange` (two columns, a Close button), and `hotkey` also toggles that dialog with ? (ignored while typing in a field).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/shortcut-sheet.tsx
- Exports: ShortcutSheet
- Embeds: Button, Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogRoot, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, Icon, IconButton, Kbd, ModalLayer, OverlayPortal, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Stat card (`stat`, ~6.5k tokens)

KPI tile: label, a ▲ / ▼ delta pill tinted by whether the change is good, a rolling value and an area sparkline along the bottom. Set `lowerIsBetter` for metrics like churn, where a fall is good news. Without `delta`, the change is computed from `trend` (last point vs `compareTo` points earlier). The label wraps and the delta pill drops below it rather than clipping; the value shrinks in narrow tiles. Lay tiles out with StatGrid.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/stat.tsx
- Exports: StatCard, StatGrid
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, DeltaBadge, SparkChart
- npm: motion, react

### Task list (`task-list`, ~11.4k tokens)

To-do list built on AnimatedList: type and press Enter (or Add) to add, an empty submit shakes the input, ticking an item draws the check and strikes the text through, ✕ slides it out while the rest close up.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/task-list.tsx
- Exports: TaskList
- Embeds: AnimatedList, Button, CheckMark, CheckboxBox, Icon, IconButton, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Virtual list (`virtual-list`, ~9.8k tokens)

A scrolling list that renders only the items in view. Items measure themselves (variable heights are fine); pass a fixed `estimateSize` and `measure={false}` for uniform rows. `role` sets the container role and each item's (`list` → listitem, `listbox` → option, `feed` → article, `log` → none), with aria-setsize/aria-posinset so screen readers count the whole set. `anchor="end"` makes a chat log: it starts at the bottom, stays pinned there as messages arrive or stream in, and keeps the reader's place when older ones are prepended (give `getItemKey`). `window` scrolls with the page instead of inside a box. `onEndReached` loads more. `ref` gives scrollToIndex etc.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/virtual-list.tsx
- Exports: VirtualList, useVirtual
- npm: react, react-dom


## Layout

### Kanban (`kanban`, ~30.5k tokens)

Board with rich cards. Drag cards between columns (drops at the pointer's position) and drag a column header to reorder columns. Keys: each card has a drag-handle button (⠿); arrows move focus between cards, Alt + arrows move the card, Alt + Shift + ← / → move its column. Columns with a `limit` turn red past it. "+ Add card" opens an inline textarea (Enter adds). On touch, press and hold a card to pick it up.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/kanban.tsx
- Exports: Kanban
- Embeds: Avatar, AvatarStack, Badge, Button, Collapse, DeltaBadge, Icon, IconButton, ScrollEdges, Slot, SparkChart, Spinner, StatusIcon
- npm: motion, react

### Sortable list (`sortable-list`, ~13.3k tokens)

Reorderable list. Drag the ⠿ handle (only the handle starts a drag, so text stays selectable), or focus a row and press Alt + ↑ / ↓ (the new position is announced). Rows show their rank and an optional colour dot.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sortable-list.tsx
- Exports: SortableList, useDragSort
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Split pane (`split-pane`, ~15.0k tokens)

Two resizable panes, side by side or stacked (nest one inside another for IDE layouts). Drag the divider, or focus it and use the arrow keys (Shift for big steps); Enter or double-click resets with a spring. Releasing the first pane below `min` snaps it closed; drag the divider back out to reopen it. Side-by-side panes stack (first on top) while the pane is narrower than `stackBelow` px (640 by default; 0 never stacks). `magnets` (first-pane sizes in %, see useMagnet; `true` = thirds, half and the collapse point) pull the divider while dragging, with guides and the mark's name by the divider; PageUp / PageDown and Ctrl/⌘ + arrows jump between them, Alt (Option) drags freely.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/split-pane.tsx
- Exports: SplitPane
- Embeds: MagnetBubble
- npm: motion, react

### Timeline (`timeline`, ~3.1k tokens)

Activity feed grouped by day. Prepend items (with new ids) and they slide in while the rest move down.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/timeline.tsx
- Exports: Timeline
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Tree view (`tree-view`, ~18.9k tokens)

File tree with roving focus: ↑ / ↓ move, → opens or steps into a folder, ← closes or jumps to the parent, Home / End jump, Enter opens (folders toggle, files call `onOpen`). F2 renames any row (file or folder) in place; double-click renames a file. Folders show their item count, files their size; icons are coloured by extension. `compact` gives denser rows without the counts (for side panels such as an IDE explorer). Trees of more than 300 nodes (or `virtualize`) render only the visible rows of the flattened open nodes inside a `height` px scroller, with aria-level / aria-setsize / aria-posinset on each row, so 10k-node trees stay instant. `lines` draws thread lines (Reddit / VS Code style): a vertical guide per level from each open folder down through its children, with an elbow into each child row. They are drawn per row, so they follow the open/close animation and virtualisation; the selected row's branch is highlighted, and so is a line under the pointer. Clicking a line collapses that folder (and selects it); keyboard users use ← instead, so the lines are not in the Tab order. `'hover'` shows them only while the pointer or focus is in the tree (always on touch screens). Turning them on or off never moves a row: the indent is the same either way.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/tree-view.tsx
- Exports: TreeView
- Embeds: Collapse, Icon
- npm: motion, react, react-dom


## Editors and content

### Address autocomplete (`address-autocomplete`, ~22.0k tokens)

Address search over `addresses` (your data or a geocoder's results): after 2 characters it lists up to five matches (the typed part bolded, city and country beside it). Picking one (click, or ↑ ↓ Enter) fills City, Postcode and Country one after another with a brief highlight. Escape closes the list without closing a dialog around it.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/address-autocomplete.tsx
- Exports: AddressAutocomplete
- Embeds: CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, Icon, OptionList
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Emoji input (`emoji-input`, ~12.9k tokens)

Text field with an emoji button: the picker inserts at the caret and remembers recent picks, and every pick also adds a reaction chip with a count below (click a chip to take one back).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/emoji-input.tsx
- Exports: EmojiInput
- Embeds: EmojiPicker, FloatingPanel
- npm: motion, react

### Emoji picker (`emoji-picker`, ~8.9k tokens)

Emoji panel: category tabs, a search field (shows "N results" or an empty state), a Recent row, and an 8-column grid you can walk with the arrow keys. Calls `onPick` with the emoji; Escape calls `onClose`.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/emoji-picker.tsx
- Exports: EmojiPicker
- npm: motion, react

### Markdown (`markdown`, ~24.5k tokens)

Markdown for model output (GFM subset: headings, emphasis, strikethrough, code, fences (plain, or `renderCode`), quotes, nested and task lists, tables, rules, links, autolinks, hard breaks, `[n]` citations). Builds React nodes only; raw HTML shows as text; links are limited to https, http, mailto and relative URLs, and absolute ones open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"`; images are links unless `images="allow"`. With `streaming`, completed blocks don't re-render as text arrives, and unfinished syntax at the end never flashes as raw characters.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/markdown.tsx
- Exports: Markdown, parseMarkdown
- Embeds: Button, CopyButton, Icon, InlineCode, ScrollEdges, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Mentions input (`mentions-input`, ~27.6k tokens)

Message box with `@` mentions and `/` commands. Typing either opens a list at the caret; ↑ ↓ choose, Enter or Tab inserts a non-editable token, Escape closes. With the list closed, Enter sends (Shift+Enter for a new line) and an empty send wiggles. Paste and drop insert plain text only; segments come only from tokens this component inserted (lookalike markup dropped or pasted in is sent as text), with the value rebuilt from `people` / `commands` (both empty by default; the placeholder mentions @ and / only when there is something to pick).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/mentions-input.tsx
- Exports: MentionsInput
- Embeds: Avatar, Button, CheckMark, CheckboxBox, FloatingPanel, Icon, MenuLabel, OptionList, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Rich text editor (`rich-text-editor`, ~14.7k tokens)

Rich text editor on contentEditable. Toolbar buttons light up for the formatting under the caret; selecting text shows a floating bubble (bold, italic, underline, link). ⌘B / ⌘I / ⌘U / ⌘K work, and at the start of a line "# ", "## ", "- ", "1. " and "> " turn into headings, lists and quotes. The footer counts words and read time and shows "Saving… / Saved". `onChange` receives the HTML (debounced; a pending save is flushed when the editor unmounts). Everything that becomes HTML (`defaultValue`, dropped content, the `onChange` output) goes through `sanitize` (default `sanitizeRichText`; pass DOMPurify with your own config if you need more). Paste inserts plain text.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/rich-text-editor.tsx
- Exports: RichTextEditor, sanitizeRichText
- Embeds: Icon
- npm: motion, react

### Signature pad (`signature-pad`, ~10.8k tokens)

Signature pad on a canvas. Strokes are smoothed with quadratic curves and get thinner the faster you move (or follow pen pressure). Undo removes one stroke, Clear removes all, Confirm checks there is a signature (it wiggles if not) and passes a PNG data URL. Redraws in the right ink colour on theme changes and resizes. Works with mouse, pen and touch.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/signature-pad.tsx
- Exports: SignaturePad
- Embeds: Button, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Unsaved changes bar (`unsaved-changes-bar`, ~9.4k tokens)

Save bar for a form with unsaved changes: slides up inside its (relative, overflow-hidden) container while `open`. Bump `shake` to wiggle it after a failed validation. `saving` swaps the Save label for a spinner.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/unsaved-changes-bar.tsx
- Exports: UnsavedChangesBar, useFormDraft
- Embeds: Button, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

Hierarchy laid out as a tidy tree in a fixed-height canvas that scrolls inside (the page never moves). Connectors draw themselves in after every change. Click a node's count to fold its team (the badge then shows "+N" people hidden); Expand all opens everything. Wide charts open scaled to fit the width (down to 55%, then they scroll, centred); "Actual size" switches to 100%. Nodes move by transform.

### Scheduler (`scheduler`, ~32.6k tokens)

Calendar with Day, Week, Month and Year views (plus 3-day on phones). In Day/Week, drag on empty time to create an event (then type its title), drag an event to move it (across days too) or its bottom edge to resize, all on a 15-minute snap. In Month, drag chips between days. Click any date to zoom in; ← / → and the arrows page through time. Under ~640px it opens on a 3-day view, the week swipes sideways with snap, month cells show dots, and tapping an event shows its details. On touch, press and hold to create or move (a swipe keeps scrolling); a tapped (selected) event drags straight away and shows a resize grip.

## Media

### Audio player (`audio-player`, ~23.9k tokens)

Audio player: cover, title, back / forward 10 s, speed cycle and a waveform you click or drag to seek (hovering previews the jump; on touch, tap or swipe sideways along it, while a vertical swipe still scrolls the page). The waveform is a slider: ← / → seek 2 s, Home / End, Space plays. Pass `track` (createAudioTrack) to share playback with other players, or just `src`.

### Avatar cropper (`avatar-cropper`, ~21.9k tokens)

Avatar cropper: the photo sits under a circular mask; drag (or arrow keys) to reposition, clamped so the circle stays covered; zoom with the slider, the wheel, a two-finger pinch or + / −. "Choose photo" loads a local file and 48 / 32 / 22 px previews update live. `onChange` receives the 256 px circle crop as a PNG data URL once the crop settles (not on every pointer move). Chosen files must be images of at most `maxBytes` (15 MB) and `maxPixels` (40 megapixels, checked from the header before anything is drawn); they load as object URLs, revoked when replaced or on unmount. A rejected file shows why (and calls `onError`).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/avatar-cropper.tsx

Full-screen image viewer. Opens from (and closes back into) the thumbnail `originFor(id)` returns. Touch: swipe sideways to change, pinch or double-tap to zoom, swipe down to close. Renders in the themed overlay layer with the shared scroll lock; focus is trapped while open; the chrome respects the safe areas.

### Masonry gallery (`masonry-gallery`, ~21.4k tokens)

Pinterest-style masonry: each tile drops into the shortest column; columns follow the width (two on phones). On touch screens the Save button and the title overlay are always visible (no hover there). Category chips filter with a reflow, "Load more" staggers new tiles in (and says "That’s everything" when `hasMore` is false), Save toggles per tile, and clicking opens the Lightbox from the tile. The layout comes from each item's `ratio` (height / width), so the full height is reserved before any image loads and nothing below moves; tiles fade in when the gallery scrolls into view.

The card itself is not a control (only the bookmark is); wrap the title in a link to make it open something.

### Video player (`video-player`, ~32.7k tokens)

Video player with custom controls: big play button, title that fades while playing, seek bar with buffer, hover time and drag, back 5 s, mute + volume, time, speed cycle and fullscreen. Controls hide when idle. Keys (when the player itself is focused): Space / K play, ← / → seek 2 s, M mute, F fullscreen. Its controls keep their own keys (the seek bar: ← / → and Home / End), so nothing fires twice. Touch: tap shows or hides the controls (tap while paused plays), double-tap the left or right half to seek ∓5 s, and the seek bar and buttons grow to finger size. Clicking the picture toggles playback. While `preparing` (no `src` yet) the poster shows with Play enabled: pressing it shows "Starting…" and playback begins as soon as the source arrives (press again to cancel).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/video-player.tsx
- Exports: VideoPlayer
- Embeds: Badge, Button, FormFieldContext, Icon, IconButton, MagnetBubble, MagnetMarks, Slider, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Voice note (`voice-note`, ~16.7k tokens)

Chat-style voice note bubble: play, a waveform you tap or drag to seek, elapsed / total time and a speed chip.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/voice-note.tsx
- Exports: VoiceNote
- Embeds: Icon, Waveform
- npm: motion, react

### Waveform (`waveform`, ~1.2k tokens)

Waveform bars from `peaks` (0..1 each). `played` (0..1) colours the bars before it, `hover` (0..1) previews a seek, `bars` resamples to that many bars. `intro` grows the bars in the first time they scroll into view; `live` makes them bounce (a listening microphone). Bars stretch to fill the width unless `barWidth` fixes it. Decorative (aria-hidden): put it inside the control that owns the value (useSeekSlider).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/waveform.tsx
- Exports: Waveform
- npm: motion, react

The thread slides on switching; a reply that lands while you are elsewhere bumps that conversation's unread count, and background threads occasionally ping. Under ~860px the details pane becomes a slide-over; under ~620px the list and thread swap.

## Pages

### Settings page (`settings-page`, ~31.4k tokens)

Settings page: section nav at the start (pill slides; ↑/↓, Home/End move between sections), the panel slides in from the direction you moved. Every change autosaves: toggles and selects at once, text after a pause or on blur, then a "Saved ✓" flash instead of a Save button. Under ~600px the nav becomes a scrolling row (←/→) with edge fades, keeping the open section in view. `onSave` may return a promise; the flash waits for it.

## Charts

### Bar list (`bar-list`, ~8.9k tokens)

Ranked horizontal bars: top pages, countries, referrers. Bars grow in when scrolled into view (a clip-path wipe, no reflow). Hover a row or arrow-key through them to highlight one; the values are always printed.

### Box violin chart (`box-violin-chart`, ~13.2k tokens)

Distributions per group: box (median, quartiles, 1.5 × IQR whiskers), KDE violin, or both, with outliers as dots. Hover or tap a box or outlier for numbers. New values morph in place.

### Bullet chart (`bullet-chart`, ~10.9k tokens)

Bullet chart: qualitative bands, the actual bar (green when it meets its target, neutral grey when not) and a target tick, one row per measure. Bars grow in when scrolled into view; hover, tap or arrow-key a row for numbers.

### Calendar heatmap (`calendar-heatmap`, ~11.3k tokens)

GitHub-style contribution grid in 4 levels with a Less → More legend. `values` maps core dayKey(date) → count. `end` is the last day shown (default: today, read after mount so server and client render the same). Built on Heatmap; cells size to fit, and on touch screens stay tappable and scroll inside the card (newest week in view, days pinned).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/calendar-heatmap.tsx

### Chart (`chart`, ~25.8k tokens)

The cartesian chart. Mix series types freely: line <Chart data x="month" series={[{ key: 'revenue' }]} curve="monotone" /> stacked area series={[{ key: 'a', type: 'area' }, { key: 'b', type: 'area' }]} stacked grouped / stacked bars series={[{ key: 'a', type: 'bar' }, { key: 'b', type: 'bar' }]} (stacked) combo, two axes series={[{ key: 'orders', type: 'bar' }, { key: 'rate', axis: 'right', points: true }]} forecast / confidence band={{ lower: 'lo', upper: 'hi' }} plus a dashed series; nulls leave gaps histogram bars with gap={0} (1px separators) waterfall { type: 'float', from: 'start', key: 'end', connectors: true, labelOf, colorOf } candlestick { type: 'float', from: 'open', key: 'close', whisker: { low: 'low', high: 'high' }, axis: 'right' } error bars { type: 'float', from: 'floor', key: 'mean', whisker: { low: 'lo', high: 'hi', caps: true } } Hover, tap or drag a finger sideways for a crosshair and tooltip (`tooltip` replaces its body); tap outside to dismiss. Keyboard: the chart is one Tab stop; arrows, Home and End move the same crosshair and tooltip (useChartFocus). Draws in when scrolled into view.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/chart.tsx

- Embeds: TagGlyph, TagTooltip
- npm: motion, react

### Density histogram (`density-histogram`, ~12.7k tokens)

Histogram with a kernel-density curve, mean (dashed), median and a ±1σ shaded band. `bins` is usually driven by a slider; bins, density and markers all morph when it or the data changes. Hover or tap a bar for its range and count.

### Donut chart (`donut-chart`, ~11.9k tokens)

Share of a total. variant 'donut' (default; pie with thickness = size/2) or 'polar' (polar area: equal angles, radius by value). Hover or tap a slice or legend row to focus it (tap outside to clear). Sweeps in when scrolled into view.

### Forest plot (`forest-plot`, ~12.5k tokens)

Forest plot: effect sizes with 95% CI whiskers, squares sized by inverse-variance weight, a pooled diamond and a zero line. Rows whose interval clears 0 are coloured as significant. New rows morph in place; hover or tap a row for its numbers. Below 400px wide the right column shows the effect only (the interval stays drawn and is in the tooltip).

Half-circle gauge. The arc sweeps and the number rolls up when scrolled into view, and again whenever `value` changes. Colour comes from `color`, or from `thresholds` (fraction of the range → colour). `label` is the caption under the number.

Cells fade in when scrolled into view; hover or tap a cell (slide a finger across) for its value in the footer, or focus the grid and move with the arrow keys. `shade` maps value/max → colour. On touch screens cells grow to at least `touchCell`; when the grid is wider than its box it scrolls inside it with the row labels pinned (`scrollTo` picks the start edge).

Scatter with a least-squares fit, the 95% confidence band for the mean and (optionally) the wider 95% prediction interval. Hover, tap or slide a finger for a crosshair readout; a stats footer shows slope, intercept, R², residual SE and n. New `points` morph in place.

### Treemap (`treemap`, ~12.1k tokens)

Squarified treemap: area ∝ value. Tiles grow out of their centres when scrolled into view and re-flow with a spring when values change; both run on transforms (motion layout animations), never on left/top/width/height. Hover, tap or arrow-key a tile to highlight it and see its share. `show` picks the second line: value or percent.

## Diagrams

### Data flow (`data-flow`, ~30.3k tokens)

Streaming pipeline: particles leave each source at its event rate, pass through the processing engine (its stage label cycles) and fan out to destinations by share. Hover, tap or focus a node to trace its path. Speed slider, Pause, and a live stat strip (throughput, processed, in flight, p95 latency). Below 560px the pipeline turns vertical (sources above the engine, destinations below) so labels stay full size on phones. Particles are drawn on one canvas from per-path lookup tables (no DOM reads or writes per frame), capped at 120 in flight, and everything pauses while the diagram is off screen.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/data-flow.tsx
- Exports: DataFlow
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, Button, FormFieldContext, MagnetBubble, MagnetMarks, Slider, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Gantt (`gantt`, ~30.4k tokens)

Project plan. Phases collapse; drag a bar to move it, drag its right edge (or Shift + arrow keys) to change its duration, snapping to days. Dependants reschedule, and Links, Critical path, Baseline and Workload overlays toggle. Tasks with duration 0 are milestones; `milestone` (default: the last one) anchors the critical path. Thin connectors drop from each phase bar to its tasks' starts (brighter for the task under the pointer). On touch: tap a bar for its details and links, long-press it to move it, or drag the grip on its right edge to resize, so swipes over the chart still scroll. Narrow screens scroll the timeline inside the card, task names pinned.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/gantt.tsx
- Exports: Gantt
- Embeds: Avatar, Button, Chip, Collapse, Icon, PointerTooltip, ScrollEdges, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### Network graph (`network-graph`, ~12.9k tokens)

Force-directed graph (repulsion, springs, centring) simulated in-file. Drag a node to pin it while you move it, hover, tap or focus a node to highlight its neighbours (tap it again or outside to clear), Shuffle to re-scatter. Nodes catch touches in a wider ring; swipes over empty canvas still scroll the page. Settles when scrolled into view. The simulation pauses while the graph is off screen or hidden (width 0) and resumes where it was when it comes back; it stops once it has cooled down, and while it runs it moves the nodes by writing their attributes directly (no re-render per frame).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/network-graph.tsx
- Exports: NetworkGraph
- Embeds: Button, Slot, Spinner
- npm: motion, react

### Process flow (`process-flow`, ~17.3k tokens)

Workflow canvas. Run executes `steps` in order: edges pulse, nodes spin then tick, counters roll and a status pill logs progress. Drag nodes by their header; drag the background to pan; Ctrl/⌘ + scroll zooms at the pointer; +, − and Fit buttons. On touch a vertical swipe scrolls the page, so pan with a sideways drag or two fingers (which also pinch-zoom). Reset cancels a run.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/process-flow.tsx
- Exports: ProcessFlow
- Embeds: Button, Icon, Slot, Spinner, StatusIcon
- npm: motion, react

### Sankey (`sankey`, ~8.1k tokens)

Two-column Sankey: source nodes on the left, targets on the right, ribbons sized by value with % labels. Hover, tap (or focus) a ribbon or a node to isolate its flows; tap outside to clear. The ribbons wipe in when scrolled into view.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/sankey.tsx
- Exports: Sankey
- Embeds: PointerTooltip
- npm: motion, react, react-dom

### State diagram (`state-diagram`, ~17.1k tokens)

Interactive UML state diagram. Fire the events available from the current state (buttons, or auto-play); a dot walks the transition, composites light while any substate is current, and a shallow history state returns to the substate you left. Shows the current state, its context and a history log. Reset restarts.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/state-diagram.tsx
- Exports: StateDiagram
- Embeds: Button, Icon, ScrollEdges, Slot, Spinner, Statechart
- npm: motion, react

### State machine (`state-machine`, ~26.0k tokens)

Live statechart of workflow machines, switchable with a segmented control. A shared WorkflowEngine runs while the chart is on screen: lit states hold jobs (with a count), dots travel each transition as it happens, guards and fork / join are labelled. Fire event queues the selected workflow's trigger; the log shows the latest decisions. Pass your `machines` (the agent-team sample is `AGENT_WORKFLOWS` in `@lyndon/ui/examples`); without any it shows an empty chart of the same size.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/state-machine.tsx
- Exports: StateMachine, WorkflowEngine
- Embeds: ActiveIndicator, Badge, Button, FormFieldContext, Icon, ScrollEdges, SegmentedControl, Slot, Spinner, Statechart
- npm: motion, react

### Statechart (`statechart`, ~11.3k tokens)

SVG statechart: composite states, states, pseudo states (initial, final, history), labelled transitions, and dots that travel along a transition (each dot calls onDone when it arrives). Pure renderer: pass the geometry and flags; StateDiagram and StateMachine drive it. It scales down to `minWidth` and scrolls sideways below that; on phones and touch screens it stays at full size (labels stay ≥ 11px) and shows a swipe hint.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/statechart.tsx
- Exports: Statechart
- Embeds: Icon, ScrollEdges
- npm: motion, react

### Trace waterfall (`trace-waterfall`, ~27.1k tokens)

Nested spans on one streaming timeline (agent runs, API requests, jobs). Plays when scrolled into view: bars grow with a cursor, the stat strip rolls (duration, cost, tokens, calls, errors) and a Live badge settles to Complete. Groups collapse. `failure` lets Simulate failure fail a span part-way and reveal its retry. Spawn connectors run from each parent bar, at the moment a child starts, down to that child's bar; hovering or tapping a span highlights its chain back to the root. Hover or tap a span for its numbers. On phones the timeline scrolls sideways with the span names pinned. `annotations` (deploys, approvals, retries; `at` in ms from the trace start) draw as dashed rules over the time grid with flags in a row of their own (reserved up front, so rows never move); flags that would overlap drop out to a dot on their rule, and `annotationStyle="rug"` shows icons instead, folding crowded ones into "+N". Hover, tap or focus a flag for its tooltip; the flag row is one Tab stop (←/→, Home/End, Escape).

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/trace-waterfall.tsx
- Exports: TraceWaterfall
- Embeds: AnimatedNumber, Badge, Button, Collapse, Icon, PointerTooltip, ScrollEdges, Slot, Spinner, TagGlyph
- npm: motion, react, react-dom


## Maps

### Globe (`globe`, ~20.3k tokens)

3D dot globe on a canvas: land as dots, great-circle routes between hubs with travelling heads, pulsing hubs with labels. Drag to spin (it keeps its momentum), toggle auto-rotate, hover or tap a route in the side list to highlight it. On touch only sideways drags spin it, so vertical swipes keep scrolling the page; on phones the canvas is no taller than it is wide. Colours come from the theme tokens and are re-read when the theme changes. The land points load on first render (`loadGlobeLand`) unless you pass `land`; the canvas has its final size from the start.

- File: https://lantos1618.github.io/oneshot-ui/files/globe.tsx

### World map (`world-map`, ~34.1k tokens)

World choropleth by country with a metric switch. Five-step ramp from the accent, pulsing hub markers, a hover or tap tooltip per country, a legend and a top-countries list whose bars animate; hover or tap a row to spotlight that country (tap outside to clear). The list sits under the map on narrow screens. Countries fade in from west to east when scrolled into view. The country outlines load on first render (`loadWorldMap`); until then a placeholder of the map's exact size shimmers in its place (also what the server renders). Pass `map` to supply them yourself.
